learned: 2026-10-05, by agent pass: the New York 'where to buy' page (about 90 NY dispensaries, each followed by the Olio products it carries): 773 paragraphs, about 675 product lines, 31 distinct products plus a 510 battery. The page was last modified 2026-02-18.
notes: NY only: this is Olio's New York page (the brand also has Colorado, Michigan and New Mexico pages). It is a stock list by store, not a shop, so each product appears once per store carrying it; the script keeps one entry per product and size.

Product lines are '<dose> – Live Rosin All In One – <strain>', '<dose> – Live Rosin Cartridge – <strain>', '100mg – Traditional Live Rosin Gummies – <flavor>' and '<strain> – 1G Cold Cure Live Rosin'. Vape sizes are given as mg of oil (1000mg AIO, 500mg cart); sizes.py reads 1000mg as 1g for a vape.

Not products: store names (all capitals, 'BAYSIDE CANNABIS – QUEENS'), the page's own headings, its 'contact your location' line and the footer (emails, sign-up, copyright). The first store's paragraph wraps its product paragraphs, so its text is a whole list; each of those lines is also an item of its own, so the wrapper is skipped.

Inline markup splits a word on a few stores' lines ('Sour Cranberry', 'Live Rosin Cartridge', 'Live Rosin'), and the text comes out with a space inside the word. Lines with a lone capital before a lowercase fragment, or a lone trailing letter other than the 'x' of a cross ('Sour D x Wilson'), are skipped; other stores list those products whole.
The 510 Thread Battery is an accessory. 'Le’Moon Cake' (concentrate) and 'Le Moon Cake' (vapes) are one strain; the product key ignores the apostrophe.

skip.why: an NY store's name or a page heading
a store's whole list in one paragraph (each line is also its own item)
a word split by inline markup (other stores list the product whole)
